messages:
Alex: Heads-up — new regression on multilingual translation tests after Q4 quant bring-up. Failing in mixed CJK+Arabic samples (ZH+AR) where token boundaries get mangled.
Jia: saw that in the nightly too. Quick summary from eval-bot: BLEU drop ~6pt on zh-ar testset, hallucination rate up on RTL segments.
Mike: can you paste the failing example(s)?
Alex: sure — example from testset 'multi_2026/zh_ar_small.tsv':

Jia: "original: 这是测试。 مرحبا"
Jia: "reference: 这是一个测试。 مرحبا"
Jia: "q8_output: 这是测试。 مرحبا"
Jia: "q4_output: 这是 测试 。 مرحبا‎" <-- note the weird spacing in CJK and stray unicode Bidi mark before Arabic.

Olga: interesting — looks like tokenizer introduced extra spaces for CJK when model emits combined script tokens. Could be subword split policy + quant noise.
Ciara: also noticed left-to-right markers (LRM/RLM) appearing in outputs for RTL segments after quant. Might be a postprocessing bug.
eval-bot: nightly-run: multi-metric summary: BLEU_zhar: 12.4 -> 6.1, chrF: 0.47 -> 0.39, hallucination_rate: 0.03 -> 0.08, token_boundary_errors: 182 -> 430.
Mike: which repo/commit triggered the q4 rollout? I want to bisect.
Alex: rollout was on commit 0a9f3b (runtime/quant/qconfig: enable aggressive group norm) deployed 1790000000. Canary traffic was 10%.
Jia: repro steps:
```
# reproduce locally
python eval/run_translate.py --model rwinf/mix-q4 --dataset multi_2026/zh_ar_small.tsv --batch 16
```

Olga: quick triage idea: compare tokenization outputs for q8 vs q4 logits -> argmax differences. Jia can run token-level diff with `tools/token_diff.py --left q8.out --right q4.out`.
Ciara: I've started a short eval job to run per-script tokenization stats + char-level alignments. ETA ~45m.
Mike: if it's tokenizer-caused, we can patch postprocess to normalize CJK no-space and strip bidi marks as a short-term mitigation for canary.
Alex: agreed. Plan: 1) Jia runs token_diff and posts top-20 mismatch cases. 2) Ciara finishes per-script stats. 3) Olga tries a nightly with q4 but consumer-level postproc to strip U+200E/U+200F and collapse spaces in CJK. 4) Hold broader rollout until we have root cause. I'll open a PR for the mitigation.
Jia: posting diffs to thread in ~30m. @Olga can you reserve a canary slot?
Olga: reserving 10% canary, pausing auto-rollout.
Mike: also log in incidents if we see customer-facing errors. tagging #incidents if any spike.
Alex: thanks — keeping thread here. If anyone finds concrete root cause (tokenizer rule vs quant noise) ping me directly.
Ciara: updated: eval job finished, attaching top aggregated stat: CJK_space_insertions concentrated at merge points between CJK and Arabic tokens. Suspect model's tokenizer learned a boundary token representing combined-script transition.
Alex: good find. Let's iterate tomorrow with a reduced model and deterministic quant to check noise.
